    static class Matrix {

                }
            }
            return ans;
        }

        boolean equals(Matrix b) {

    static int k;

    static Matrix[] shift = new Matrix[maxb];
    static long[] val = new long[maxb];

    static void mkay(int a) {
        if (a >= mod)

        else if (a < 0)

    public static void main(String[] args) {
